title: ESTIMETR Project Lifecycle
description: เปิดให้สร้างและเข้าดูโครงการ ESTIMETR ได้จริงบนตาราง projects ที่มีอยู่ โดยเพดาน 1 โครงการของสิทธิ์ทดลองถูกบังคับที่ write path ไม่ใช่ที่ปุ่ม และทุก query ผูก organization เพื่อกันการเข้าถึงข้ามองค์กร
scope: create and read ESTIMETR projects through a single organization-scoped repository
enforce the trial project cap inside the write transaction with a row lock, not on the screen
reject cross-organization project access at the query, not by hiding a link
record project creation in audit_events with the entitlement state that allowed it
retire the root todo.md by moving its unfinished items into the roadmap
verification: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm test (63 passed with the opt-in database suites enabled) and pnpm build pass
unit tests cover project name parsing and the denial message for trial cap, expiry, suspension, not-started and unlimited entitlements

opt-in PostgreSQL tests cover the refused second project, the audit record naming the entitlement that allowed the write, a second submit waiting on the organization lock, cross-organization reads returning nothing, reads surviving expiry and a missing organization
the lock test was confirmed to fail when the row lock is removed, so it detects the real race rather than passing by timing
unauthenticated requests to /apps/estimeter, /apps/estimeter/projects/new and /apps/estimeter/projects/{id} all returned the access gate, and /apps/rcopt still resolves through the dynamic app route
GitHub push and release tag pending user approval
rollback: Revert the slice 2 commit or return to tag v0.13.0-estimeter-entitlement-runtime. No migration runs in this release. Rows written to projects and audit_events remain valid; reverting only removes the routes that read them.
constraints: No schema change or migration in this release; projects is used as shipped by migration 0000.
Project path (private/government), province and price month are deliberately not collected yet because projects has no column for them; they arrive with the schema slice.
Server Actions are public POST endpoints, so authentication, entitlement and organization scope are re-checked inside every action.
